Mid and high rating Premier is its own kind of hell. Spinbots, aimlock, barely even hidden. From what I see in my games, VAC Live catches basically nothing in real time.

Why is that my problem? Why does a separate company, which isn’t even Valve (it’s owned by a Saudi state-backed group), have to do the job Valve should be doing on its own servers? The funniest part is that regular players are doing Valve’s job for free. A guy from NTNU in Norway wrote his master’s thesis on making bans follow the person, not the account. His system looks at demos and recognizes a player by how they move the mouse and press keys. On 1000+ players it almost always picked the right person and even found smurfs nobody knew about.

Another guy built an open source server-side anticheat for community servers, CS2AC, with 17 detection modules: aim, silent aim, bhop and more. One person.
https://github.com/karola3vax/CS2AC
And a billion dollar company apparently can’t.

So players are writing theses and anticheats, and Valve is releasing another case.

Don’t buy skins and don’t open cases until they actually fix anticheat. Money is the only thing they notice.
